svg.text: $ ipa-diagnose access carol app01.lab.test sshd (exit 0)
REAL LIVE CAPTURE - FreeIPA 4.13.4 / Fedora 43 lab - commit b58f3d6, run 36742907967
ipa-diagnose access: carol -> app01.lab.test via sshd
LIVE; asked FreeIPA as admin@LAB.TEST on ipa01.lab.test (API 4.13.4)
FreeIPA HBAC policy authorizes carol to access app01.lab.test through sshd.
AUTHENTICATION NOT VERIFIED the IPA account exists and is enabled; no credential was tested
AUTHORIZATION PASS FreeIPA HBAC policy allows this request (rule: r_nested)
RUNTIME ACCESS NOT VERIFIED not tested; the host has no keytab in FreeIPA, so it may not be enrolled
no login was attempted; the host's SSSD, PAM configuration, network path and keytab were
not checked
ROOT CAUSE
no blocker found in FreeIPA HBAC policy or in the account attributes read (disabled, principal expiry, preserved). Not
checked: whether the password or other credential is valid, and lockout after failed logins.
WHY
Matched rule r_nested (enabled) - user: carol is a nested member of devs (carol -> backend -> devs) | host: app01.lab.
test listed directly | service: sshd listed directly
ALSO NOTED
FreeIPA holds no Kerberos key for app01.lab.test: The host entry exists but has no keytab, which usually means it is n
ot (or no longer) enrolled: SSSD on it cannot use FreeIPA, whatever the policy says. Runtime access is not checked by th
is command.
CHECKED FOR YOU
[ok ] user carol exists, enabled, no principal expiration set or readable; 2 direct and 1 nested groups
[!! ] host app01.lab.test exists; 0 direct and 0 nested hostgroups; no keytab in IPA
[ok ] HBAC service sshd is defined; in 0 service group(s)
[ok ] FreeIPA evaluated 13 enabled HBAC rule(s): access granted; matched: r_nested
[ok ] rule r_nested: enabled
[ok ] group devs contains backend of this object's groups (read to explain the nesting)
IMPACT
FreeIPA HBAC policy is not what stops this login. If the login still fails, the cause is elsewhere (credentials, locko
ut, the host's SSSD, PAM, network or keytab), which this command does not test.
RESOLUTION
Nothing to fix in FreeIPA HBAC policy for this request.
RISK
None from this command: it only reads.
VERIFY
ipa hbactest --user=carol --host=app01.lab.test --service=sshd (FreeIPA's own evaluation, read-only)
ipa user-status carol (read-only; failed logins and lockout on each server)
on app01.lab.test, as root: ipa-diagnose access carol app01.lab.test sshd --runtime (continues into that host's runtim
e side: SSSD, NSS, PAM stack and account phase; read-only; no login)
on app01.lab.test, as root: sssctl user-checks carol -a acct -s sshd (the host's SSSD account check for this service;
read-only; runtime evidence this command does not collect)
LIMITATIONS
Runtime access is not tested: no login is attempted, and the host's SSSD (including its offline cache), PAM stack, acc
ess_provider setting, network path and keytab are not checked.
(--details lists every limitation, the API calls made and the relationships read)
37 lines, complete; long lines folded at 120 columns, as a 120-column terminal shows them
